about: Test cases for the portable verification extension 0.2.0, over the values in vectors.json. Schema cases apply a patch to an export from the vectors (signed, unless the case names another) or to base_report (an empty patch tests the base itself), so each negative case differs from a valid instance by the one thing it tests. Vector cases recompute the vectors. Digest, chain and statement cases are as in 0.1.0, over the records and the chain. Signature cases run the reference check of one entry's signature, with the attachment beside the export (beside, unless the case names another or none) and the policy, each patched; export seal cases that of the export's seal; pairing cases read a report with its export, the attachment and the policy. Patches name a value, a value from vectors.json (vector) or a document's digest (digest_of).
